units: <cite ref="Nedarim 56b:3">Ned. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>שִׁיפַת עור הדג</he> rubbing with the skin of a fish.

senses.gloss: paring, shavings used for basket work, mats &c. (cmp. Syr. שפיתא, Brockelm. 383, שיפתא P. Sm. 4102).
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 20a:6">Succ. 20ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="H01843"><he>חֲשִׂיפָה</he></cite>. Y. Dem. II, 22ᶜ bot. <he>פול … בש׳</he> Egyptian beans (offered for sale) tied with shavings.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:14:2">Y. Ab. Zar. V, end, 45ᵇ</cite> <he>העקל … של ש׳</he> a bale … made of plaited shavings.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 5:8">Makhsh. V, 8</cite> <he>הש׳ של לבנים</he> ed. Dehr. (ed. <he>השיפא</he>) the shavings (or mat) used for covering bricks; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="U01017"><he>שִׁיפוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:2:3">Y. Sabb. IV, 6ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>פורסין מחצלת על גבי ש׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>שייפות</he>) you may spread a mat over the shavings which cover the bricks (on the Sabbath); Y. M. Kat. II, end, 81ᵇ <cite ref="U01021"><he>שיפוף</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
